title: Clinical Professor of Law, Emeritus
bio: Robert Greenwald is a Clinical Professor of Law, Emeritus at Harvard Law School and the faculty director of the Law School’s Center for Health Law and Policy Innovation (CHLPI). In addition to teaching seminars in health and public health law and policy, for over 25 years Robert has been engaged in state and national research, […]
